text: やたらと　つよい　こどもが　いると　ウワサは　きいて　いるよ

structure.jp: やたらと　つよい　こどもが　いると
structure.en: that there is an absurdly strong kid

patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.explanation: と after a statement shows that it is what was said or heard. こどもが　いると = 'that there is a kid'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: いる after a て-form shows a state that still holds: having heard and still knowing it. きいて　いる = 'I have heard'.
